scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Hello!
What's up?
I'm a specialist
for refining items,
but I don't work anymore.
I'll go on my way.
Hmm... this makes me curious.

[Refine Master]
Take care, adventurer.

[Refine Master]
Actually, I sometimes provide refine services for adventurers with a ^006400Refine Ticket^000000...
Bye bye~!

[Refine Master]
Greetings!
I can refine an item up to the ^006400same level as your ticket^000000.
You don't have to worry! There's no chance of breaking your item.
I'll come back later.
Refine item with ticket.

[Refine Master]
Okay.
You can come again later.

[Refine Master]
Which equipment would you like to refine?

[Refine Master]
You have to equip the item you want to refine.

[Refine Master]
Oh, I'm sorry.
This item is impossible to refine.

[Refine Master]
If you want to refine this ^006400{0}^000000, please come along with ^006400{1} Refine Ticket^000000.
See you later!

[Refine Master]
Please choose which ^006400{0} Refine Ticket^000000 you want to use.

[Refine Master]
{0} is not in your inventory. Did you put it in your storage?
Please check again.
See you later!

[Refine Master]
^8B4513This item is already refined as much as your deed.^000000
Please come along with an item refined less than your ticket.

[Refine Master]
I'm going to refine ^006400{0}^8B4513 up to the +{1} level^000000 with ^006400{2}^000000.
May I proceed?
No.
Yes.

[Refine Master]
Oh, you changed your mind.
Ok.
You can come back later.

[Refine Master]
Great.
As you wish!
I have my own special way to refine...
.......ka boom!

[Refine Master]
Great.
As you wish!
I have my own special way to refine...
.......ka boom!
[Refine Master]
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!

Error!
Please report this.

[Refine Master]
Alright, here it is~
Well, ^0000FF{0}^000000!
Congratulations on your shining {1}.
You look GREAT!
Farewell~!
